enforcement_authorities: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
implementation_notes: Official NIST reference page (initial publication 2025-01-21, subsequently updated through at least 2025-07-23) cataloging the congressional statutes (CHIPS and Science Act of 2022, National AI Initiative Act of 2020), America's AI Action Plan (July 2025), and Executive Orders (Jan 2025 EO 14179, rescinded Oct 2023 EO 14110, Dec 2020 EO 13960, Feb 2019 EO 13859) driving NIST's non-regulatory AI standards, testbed, cybersecurity, and evaluation activities. As a summary webpage, it imposes no direct legal obligations or enforcement mechanisms.
